contents.text: VizOutliers flagged low-value outliers on Net Invoice Quantity, including negative values. Are all negative quantities on return order types, or are some on regular invoices?

<toolcall tool="search_knowledge_base" id="call_mezwssIwdPj7IAGXiVRmKfWv" display="Searching knowledge base" details="Tabular Editor DAX query distinct values summarize columns execute_dax_query consent examples" done="true"/><toolcall tool="execute_dax_query" id="call_XqgzPyFb47YyJt3kE8n79a5m" display="Executing DAX query" details="EVALUATE
VAR Negatives =
    FILTER(
        ADDCOLUMNS(
            'Invoices',
            "DocGroup", RELATED('Invoice Document Type'[Group]),
            "DocText", RELATED('Invoice Document Type'[Text])
        ),
        'Invoices'[Net Invoice Quantity] < 0
    )
RETURN
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    Negatives[DocGroup],
    Negatives[DocText],
    "Rows", COUNTROWS(Negatives),
    "Qty", SUMX(Negatives, 'Invoices'[Net Invoice Quantity])
)
ORDER BY [Rows] DESC, [Qty] ASC" failed="true"/><toolcall tool="execute_dax_query" id="call_vUKXJbuMpnxJar0vwuYT5fWv" display="Executing DAX query" details="EVALUATE
VAR Negatives =
    FILTER(
        ADDCOLUMNS(
            'Invoices',
            "DocGroup", RELATED('Invoice Document Type'[Group]),
            "DocText", RELATED('Invoice Document Type'[Text])
        ),
        'Invoices'[Net Invoice Quantity] < 0
    )
RETURN
SUMMARIZE(
    Negatives,
    [DocGroup],
    [DocText],
    "Rows", COUNTROWS(Negatives),
    "Qty", SUMX(Negatives, 'Invoices'[Net Invoice Quantity])
)
ORDER BY [Rows] DESC, [Qty] ASC" done="true"/>Negative [Net Invoice Quantity](te3://objref/Invoices[Net Invoice Quantity]) rows are not limited to return types.

- The negatives in [Invoices](te3://objref/Invoices) all map to [Invoice Document Type](te3://objref/'Invoice Document Type') group **Adjustment**
- The visible texts are **Warranty** and **Return**
- I did not find negative quantities on regular invoice document types in this check

So: negative quantities appear to be adjustment documents, not standard invoices. 1.93M rows of them, because apparently someone enjoyed pressing the minus key.

If you want, I can also break this down by exact document type code and show whether any non-adjustment groups contain negatives.
